title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — did Adam take our law-keeping part to spare us? Away with such thoughts
pass_a_gloss: He floats then rejects the idea that our part was then to keep the law given to Adam, while Adam put himself in our place to do our duty and spare us the trouble. Away with such thoughts, he says.
pass_b_english: But perhaps our part was then to keep the law then given to Adam—to hear it, commit it to memory, understand it, carry it out. And Adam, to relieve us of that trouble, put himself in our place to fulfill our duty and play our part. Away with such thoughts.
source_text: Sed fortasse nostrae partes erant legem, tunc Adamo latam, tunc observare, atque adeo audire, memoriae mandare, intelligere, exequi. Adamus autem ut nos hac molestia levaret se suffecit in locum nostrum qui nostrum officium impleret, nostras partes ageret. Apage tales cogitationes.

choices.choice: Adam did not take our law-duty to spare us
